findings.claim: task.task_id is mutated before transition() validates the state change, so a rejected transition still leaves the task with a new id.
findings.failure_scenario: Calling retry(queue, task) on a task whose state is RUNNING (not FAILED): task.task_id is overwritten with a new uuid4 value on line 10, then transition(task, TaskState.PENDING) on line 11 raises ValueError because PENDING is not in _ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[RUNNING]. The caller catches/sees the exception and the retry is considered failed, but the task object now permanently has a different task_id than before the call, even though no state change actually occurred -- any external reference to the task by its original id (logs, queue lookups, correlation with the failed attempt) is silently broken.
